freshness_rule: A field is FRESH when observed within the last 48 hours. Older fields are labeled STALE with their last honest observation date. Timestamps are never manufactured — observed_at is written only by real verification events.

fields.label: Zooted Zone lifetime Spotify plays (307,439)
fields.note: Lifetime figure grows slowly; treat as approximate between sweeps.

fields.label: Artist monthly listeners (171)
fields.note: Monthly listeners are volatile; the honest value is the last sweep's value.

fields.label: CWI label Spotify presence (followers / following / DistroKid saves)
fields.note: Follower counts change daily; last honest observation 2026-09-15.

fields.label: Playlist claim verification states
fields.note: A claim flips to verified only on a full scan that finds the track; absence across two scans keeps it claimed_unverified.

fields.label: Node verification states (incl. playlist positions)
fields.note: Playlist positions decay fast; positions older than 48h are stale by definition.

fields.label: Evidence provenance timestamps
fields.note: These are WHEN evidence was seen, not current-state claims. They are never refreshed or relabeled; rewriting them would be fabrication.

fields.label: Verified proof points
fields.note: Proof points are point-in-time; re-verify before citing as current.

fields.label: Volatile prose figures (stream counts, positions, dates)
fields.refresh: regenerated from catalog.json on the same pipeline
fields.note: llms.txt is a human/LLM-readable rendering of catalog.json; its numbers are only as fresh as the catalog fields they quote.

endpoints.note: No volatile fields. Identity, capabilities, and endpoint URLs are stable; version bumps are manual and announced.
